verdict.rationale: Mollie Connect is documented for platforms and marketplaces. Split payments hold buyer funds in the marketplace balance and distribute set amounts to each connected seller's balance, while application fees let the platform keep a commission. Seller onboarding appears only as a referenced Connect page and an onboarding-status webhook event. missing for 10: detailed seller onboarding/KYC flow documentation, explicit evidence of payouts from seller balances to seller bank accounts, independent or hands-on corroboration.
